Privacy Policy

Last updated 2 September 2026

This page explains what personal data we hold, why we hold it, and what you can ask us to do with it. It is written to be read, not to be survived.

Who we are

The controller of your personal data is Emic Lab A.M. Chodynicka, J. Więckowska s.c., Międzyborska 80, 04-010 Warsaw, Poland. DRIFT Partners is a practice of Emic Lab.

For anything on this page, write to amc@drift.partners.

When you write or call us

If you email us or call the number on this site, we hold what you send us: your name, your address or number, and what you wrote. We use it to reply and to carry the conversation on.

The legal basis is our legitimate interest in answering people who contact us (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), and, where the conversation moves towards working together, the steps taken at your request before entering a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).

This site has no contact form. It collects nothing from you while you read it.

When we contact you first

We also hold the names and work contact details of people at organisations we have worked with, and at organisations whose work is close to what we do. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in offering our services to businesses (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Where we did not get your details from you, we got them from one of the following: our earlier work together, someone at your organisation, your organisation's own website, or a professional network such as LinkedIn. We hold your name, role, organisation and work contact details, and nothing beyond that. You can ask us at any time which of these applies to you.

If you would rather we did not, tell us and we will stop. One line is enough.

How long we keep it

  • Enquiries that do not lead to work: 24 months from our last exchange.
  • Client records: for as long as the work runs, and afterwards for the period required by Polish accounting and tax law.

Who else sees it

Only the services that make this work possible: our email provider and the company that hosts this site. They act on our instructions under written data-processing agreements. They are:

  • Microsoft 365 (Microsoft Ireland Operations Ltd), for email.
  • Cloudflare, Inc. (United States), for hosting, site delivery and site statistics.

We do not sell personal data and we do not share it for anyone else's marketing. Where a provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, that transfer is covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

Cookies and site statistics

This site uses only the cookies it needs to work, including a security cookie set by Cloudflare that protects the site from automated traffic. We do not use advertising cookies and we do not track you across other sites.

To see whether anyone reads this site, we use Cloudflare Web Analytics. It counts page views. It sets no cookies, it does not fingerprint your device, and it does not follow you anywhere else. It tells us how many people opened a page, not who they are. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in knowing whether our work is read (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). Because nothing is stored on or read from your device, there is nothing here for you to consent to, and no banner asking you to.

Your rights

You can ask us to show you what we hold, correct it, delete it, or limit what we do with it. You can ask for a copy in a portable form. You can object to any processing we base on legitimate interest, including everything described under "When we contact you first".

Write to amc@drift.partners. We answer within one month.

If you think we have got it wrong, you can complain to the Polish supervisory authority: Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw, uodo.gov.pl.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version appears here with a new date. If the change matters to you, we will say so when we next write.
